notes: TikTok connect: token exchange now includes the Client Secret when one is available locally (TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET env var or a gitignored tiktok-secret.local.json), since TikTok's token endpoint appears to require it even with PKCE — fixes 'request parameters are malformed' at the final step. The secret is never committed (repo is public). Also surfaces TikTok's exact error code + log_id in the connect popup for easier diagnosis. server.js + .gitignore.
